method.realized: Annualized root mean square of six-hour log returns of Deribit's index over 30 days, zero mean: sqrt(sum r^2 / years spanned).
method.dvol: DVOL, Deribit's 30-day implied volatility index, read at 00:00 UTC each day.
method.ours: 30-day at-the-money vol from our fitted surface: sqrt(theta(30d) / T), with theta interpolated monotonically between expiries.
method.gap_trailing: DVOL minus realized vol over the previous 30 days.
method.gap_forward: DVOL minus realized vol over the following 30 days (the volatility risk premium as it turned out); only for days at least 30 days old.
method.deribit_hv: Deribit's published historical volatility (get_historical_volatility); its window is not documented in the API.
